title: What are the benefits of going back to university
titleChinese: 重返校园的好处有哪些
paragraphs: Education is a good opportunity for those of us who strive to better ourselves. But for people in full-time employment, getting the balancing act between work and studying can prove a stumbling block. So, what are the benefits of hitting the books once in work?

Uni is often considered a logical step for people who wish to continue their education after school. While options of Master’s degrees, PhDs and other postgraduate qualifications exist, many students leave after obtaining their Bachelor’s and head into the world of work. After years of doing the same job, some feel adding new skills or knowledge to their locker may open up new opportunities or help them to get a promotion. Studying part-time in the evenings and weekends can be a great way to juggle responsibilities.

In terms of the benefits, learning new techniques that you can bring into the workplace can make you more of an authority in your area and a go-to person for advice. If the business has a skills shortage, you may be able to step up to the plate and fill that gap. In short, studying more could make you more promotable down the line and more useful to the business.

If you study in a classroom, your experience of the workplace could bring a wealth of knowledge to other students and provide real-life examples for you to draw on. You may also meet like-minded people who you can add to your professional network in the future. And while adult learners have to consider things like children, homelives and work, many adult and part-time courses are more flexible and spread over a number of years. Some courses can even be done partly or entirely online, which means that you can manage your time more easily studying from home and you don’t need to factor in travel time.
So, there are a variety of options for those who wish to return to studying. And increasing your skills may open up new careers or opportunities in your professional life.

vocabulary.entry: balancing act /ˌbælənsɪŋ ˈækt/  （在不同事物间的）平衡之举
vocabulary.example: She struggled to maintain a balancing act between work and family commitments.
vocabulary.translation: 她努力在工作和家庭责任之间找到平衡点。

vocabulary.entry: stumbling block /ˈstʌmblɪŋ blɒk/  障碍；绊脚石
vocabulary.example: Lack of funding has been the main stumbling block to the project's progress.
vocabulary.translation: 资金短缺一直是该项目进展的主要障碍。

vocabulary.entry: hit the books /hɪt ðə bʊks/  用功学习；啃书本
vocabulary.example: I need to hit the books tonight to prepare for tomorrow's exam.
vocabulary.translation: 我今晚得用功学习，为明天的考试做准备。

vocabulary.entry: postgraduate qualification /ˌpəʊstˈɡrædʒuət ˌkwɒlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/  研究生学历；研究生资格证书
vocabulary.example: A postgraduate qualification can enhance your competitiveness in the job market.
vocabulary.translation: 研究生学历能增强你在职场上的竞争力。

vocabulary.entry: Bachelor’s degree /ˌbætʃələrz dɪˈɡriː/  学士学位
vocabulary.example: He was awarded a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science last year.
vocabulary.translation: 他去年获得了计算机科学学士学位。

vocabulary.entry: add...to one's locker /æd tu wʌnz ˈlɒkə(r)/  为自己增添（技能、知识等）
vocabulary.example: She decided to add a new language to her locker to boost her career prospects.
vocabulary.translation: 她决定学一门新语言为自己充电，提升职业前景。

vocabulary.entry: promotion /prəˈməʊʃn/  晋升；提拔
vocabulary.example: Her hard work and dedication finally earned her a promotion to department manager.
vocabulary.translation: 她的勤奋和投入最终让她晋升为部门经理。

vocabulary.entry: juggle responsibilities /ˈdʒʌɡl rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪlətiz/  兼顾各项责任
vocabulary.example: Many parents struggle to juggle responsibilities between work and childcare.
vocabulary.translation: 许多父母都在努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子的责任。

vocabulary.entry: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/  （某领域的）权威人士；专家
vocabulary.example: She is widely regarded as an authority on environmental protection issues.
vocabulary.translation: 她被广泛认为是环境保护方面的权威人士。

vocabulary.entry: go-to person /ˌɡəʊ tu ˈpɜːsn/  （遇到问题时的）求助对象；关键人物
vocabulary.example: When it comes to technical problems, John is the go-to person in our team.
vocabulary.translation: 遇到技术问题时，约翰是我们团队的求助对象。

vocabulary.entry: skills shortage /ˈskɪlz ˈʃɔːtɪdʒ/  技能短缺
vocabulary.example: The industry is facing a severe skills shortage of qualified engineers.
vocabulary.translation: 该行业正面临合格工程师严重短缺的问题。

vocabulary.entry: step up to the plate /step ʌp tu ðə pleɪt/  挺身而出；迎难而上
vocabulary.example: When the team leader resigned, Sarah stepped up to the plate and took charge.
vocabulary.translation: 团队领导辞职后，萨拉挺身而出，接管了工作。

vocabulary.entry: promotable /prəˈməʊtəbl/  有晋升潜力的；值得提拔的
vocabulary.example: Employees who show initiative and willingness to learn are more promotable.
vocabulary.translation: 积极主动且愿意学习的员工更有晋升潜力。

vocabulary.entry: draw on /drɔː ɒn/  利用；借鉴；凭借
vocabulary.example: The writer drew on her own experiences to write the novel.
vocabulary.translation: 这位作家借鉴了自己的亲身经历来创作这部小说。

vocabulary.entry: like-minded /ˌlaɪk ˈmaɪndɪd/  志同道合的；志趣相投的
vocabulary.example: She joined a club to meet like-minded people who share her love for hiking.
vocabulary.translation: 她加入了一个俱乐部，结识志同道合、同样热爱徒步旅行的人。

vocabulary.entry: professional network /prəˈfeʃənl ˈnetwɜːk/  职业人脉；专业人际网络
vocabulary.example: Attending industry conferences is a good way to expand your professional network.
vocabulary.translation: 参加行业会议是拓展职业人脉的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: flexible /ˈfleksəbl/  灵活的；可变通的
vocabulary.example: The company offers flexible working hours to help employees balance work and life.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间，帮助员工平衡工作与生活。

vocabulary.entry: part-time course /ˌpɑːt taɪm kɔːs/  兼职课程；业余课程
vocabulary.example: She signed up for a part-time course in digital marketing to upgrade her skills.
vocabulary.translation: 她报名参加了一门数字营销的业余课程，提升自己的技能。

vocabulary.entry: factor in /ˈfæktə ɪn/  把……考虑进去；计入
vocabulary.example: When planning the trip, you need to factor in the cost of accommodation and transport.
vocabulary.translation: 规划旅行时，你需要把住宿和交通费用考虑进去。

vocabulary.entry: online course /ˌɒnˈlaɪn kɔːs/  在线课程；网课
vocabulary.example: Online courses allow students to study at their own pace from anywhere.
vocabulary.translation: 在线课程让学生可以在任何地方按照自己的节奏学习。

vocabulary.entry: full-time employment /ˌfʊl taɪm ɪmˈplɔɪmənt/  全职工作；全职雇佣
vocabulary.example: Full-time employment usually comes with benefits such as health insurance and paid leave.
vocabulary.translation: 全职工作通常附带医疗保险和带薪休假等福利。

sentences.english: Education is a good opportunity for those of us who strive to better ourselves.
sentences.chinese: 教育对于那些力求自我提升的人来说，是一个绝佳的机会。

sentences.english: But for people in full-time employment, getting the balancing act between work and studying can prove a stumbling block.
sentences.chinese: 但对于全职工作者而言，想要在工作和学习之间找到平衡，往往是一大障碍。

sentences.english: So, what are the benefits of hitting the books once in work?
sentences.chinese: 那么，进入职场后再重拾书本学习，究竟有哪些益处呢？

sentences.english: Uni is often considered a logical step for people who wish to continue their education after school.
sentences.chinese: 对于毕业后希望继续深造的人来说，上大学通常被视为顺理成章的一步。

sentences.english: While options of Master’s degrees, PhDs and other postgraduate qualifications exist, many students leave after obtaining their Bachelor’s and head into the world of work.
sentences.chinese: 虽然有硕士学位、博士学位以及其他研究生学历可供选择，但许多学生在获得学士学位后便踏入职场。

sentences.english: After years of doing the same job, some feel adding new skills or knowledge to their locker may open up new opportunities or help them to get a promotion.
sentences.chinese: 在从事同一份工作多年后，有些人认为，掌握新的技能或知识能为自己开拓新的机遇，或是助力自己获得晋升。

sentences.english: Studying part-time in the evenings and weekends can be a great way to juggle responsibilities.
sentences.chinese: 利用晚间和周末的时间攻读非全日制课程，是兼顾各项责任的好办法。

sentences.english: In terms of the benefits, learning new techniques that you can bring into the workplace can make you more of an authority in your area and a go-to person for advice.
sentences.chinese: 就收益而言，学习可应用于职场的新技术，能让你在所属领域更具权威性，成为他人咨询求助的对象。

sentences.english: If the business has a skills shortage, you may be able to step up to the plate and fill that gap.
sentences.chinese: 如果公司存在技能缺口，你或许能挺身而出，填补这一空白。

sentences.english: In short, studying more could make you more promotable down the line and more useful to the business.
sentences.chinese: 简而言之，深造学习能提升你未来的晋升潜力，也能让你对公司更有价值。

sentences.english: If you study in a classroom, your experience of the workplace could bring a wealth of knowledge to other students and provide real-life examples for you to draw on.
sentences.chinese: 若选择课堂学习，你的职场经验既能为其他同学带来丰富的知识，也能为你自己的学习提供真实案例参考。

sentences.english: You may also meet like-minded people who you can add to your professional network in the future.
sentences.chinese: 你还有可能结识志同道合的人，将他们纳入你未来的职业人脉网络。

sentences.english: And while adult learners have to consider things like children, homelives and work, many adult and part-time courses are more flexible and spread over a number of years.
sentences.chinese: 虽然成年学习者需要顾及子女、家庭生活和工作等诸多事宜，但许多成人及非全日制课程的灵活性更高，学制也会延长至数年。

sentences.english: Some courses can even be done partly or entirely online, which means that you can manage your time more easily studying from home and you don’t need to factor in travel time.
sentences.chinese: 部分课程甚至可以部分或全部在线上完成，这意味着你可以居家学习，更轻松地安排时间，还无需考虑通勤耗时。

sentences.english: So, there are a variety of options for those who wish to return to studying.
sentences.chinese: 由此可见，对于希望重返校园学习的人来说，选择十分多样。

sentences.english: And increasing your skills may open up new careers or opportunities in your professional life.
sentences.chinese: 而提升自身技能，则可能为你的职业生涯开辟新的道路，带来更多机遇。
